<Label text="Questions a traiter" styleClass="admin-section-title" /> <TableView fx:id="questionTable" styleClass="modern-table" prefHeight="220"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="questionObjetColumn" text="Question" prefWidth="260" /> <TableColumn fx:id="questionPrioriteColumn" text="Priorite" prefWidth="110" /> <TableColumn fx:id="questionStatutColumn" text="Statut" prefWidth="120" /> <TableColumn fx:id="questionCreatedAtColumn" text="Cree le" prefWidth="140" /> </columns> </TableView>
<TableView fx:id="responseTable" styleClass="modern-table" VBox.vgrow="ALWAYS"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="questionColumn" text="Question" prefWidth="170" /> <TableColumn fx:id="auteurTypeColumn" text="Auteur" prefWidth="90" /> <TableColumn fx:id="reponseTextColumn" text="Reponse" prefWidth="200" /> <TableColumn fx:id="reponseRoleColumn" text="Role" prefWidth="110" /> <TableColumn fx:id="actionTypeColumn" text="Action" prefWidth="120" /> <TableColumn fx:id="impactStatutColumn" text="Impact" prefWidth="110" /> <TableColumn fx:id="createdAtColumn" text="Cree le" prefWidth="130" /> <TableColumn fx:id="luParClientColumn" text="Lu" prefWidth="70" /> <TableColumn fx:id="actionsColumn" text="Actions" prefWidth="170" /> </columns> </TableView>
<HBox styleClass="pagination-bar"> <Button fx:id="prevPageBtn" text="Prev" onAction="#handlePrevPage" styleClass="button-secondary" /> <Label fx:id="pageInfoLabel" text="Page 1/1" /> <Button fx:id="nextPageBtn" text="Next" onAction="#handleNextPage" styleClass="button-secondary" /> </HBox> </VBox>
<ScrollPane fitToWidth="true" hbarPolicy="NEVER"> <VBox styleClass="admin-form-card"> <Label text="Formulaire Reponse" styleClass="admin-section-title" />
<Label text="Question" styleClass="form-label" /> <ComboBox fx:id="questionCombo" styleClass="form-combo" />
<Label text="Utilisateur (optionnel)" styleClass="form-label" /> <ComboBox fx:id="utilisateurCombo" styleClass="form-combo" />
<Label text="Auteur Type" styleClass="form-label" /> <ComboBox fx:id="auteurTypeCombo" styleClass="form-combo" />
<Label text="Reponse Role" styleClass="form-label" /> <ComboBox fx:id="reponseRoleCombo" styleClass="form-combo" />
<Label text="Action Type" styleClass="form-label" /> <ComboBox fx:id="actionTypeCombo" styleClass="form-combo" />
<Label text="Impact Statut" styleClass="form-label" /> <ComboBox fx:id="impactStatutCombo" styleClass="form-combo" />
<Label text="Reponse Text" styleClass="form-label" /> <TextArea fx:id="reponseTextArea" prefRowCount="4" styleClass="form-input" />
<CheckBox fx:id="luParClientCheck" text="Lu par client" />
<Label text="Fichier" styleClass="form-label" /> <HBox spacing="10"> <Label fx:id="fileInfoLabel" text="Aucun fichier" styleClass="text-secondary" /> <Button text="Choisir" onAction="#handleChooseFile" styleClass="button-secondary" /> </HBox>
<Label fx:id="formErrorLabel" text="" styleClass="error-label" />
